story_division.title: Submit Service Request
story_division.summary:
Customer submits a service request and attaches required information.

System receives and registers the submitted request for processing.

story_division.title: Competent Authority Review and Decision
story_division.summary:
Competent authority reviews the request and records an approve/reject decision.

System issues the decision or requested document to the customer when a no-payment request is approved.
source_refs: Workflow 1 - Step 3. Review by Competent Authority
Workflow 2 - Step 3. Review by Competent Authority

story_division.title: Customer Views Decision Result (No Payment)
story_division.summary:
Customer views the decision or downloads the output for an approved no-payment request.

System records the rejection reason when a no-payment request is rejected.

Customer can view the recorded rejection reason for a no-payment request.

story_division.title: Calculate and Notify Payment Required
story_division.summary: System calculates applicable fees and notifies the customer when an approved request requires payment.

story_division.title: Customer Makes Payment
story_division.summary: Customer proceeds to pay the applicable fees for an approved paid request.

story_division.title: Handle Payment Success/Failure Outcome
story_division.summary: System evaluates whether payment was successful and branches to output generation or payment failure handling.

story_division.title: Generate Output on Successful Payment
story_division.summary: System generates the requested document or service output after a successful payment.

story_division.title: Customer Downloads Paid Output
story_division.summary: Customer can view or download the document/output generated after successful payment.

story_division.title: Handle Failed Payment
story_division.summary: System marks the payment as failed when it could not be completed.

story_division.title: Retry Payment
story_division.summary: Customer can retry the payment after a failed payment attempt, returning to the payment step.

story_division.title: Record Rejection Reason (With Payment)
story_division.summary: System records the rejection reason when a paid-service request is rejected.

story_division.title: Customer Views Rejection Reason (With Payment)
story_division.summary: Customer can view the recorded rejection reason for a paid-service request.

user_stories.summary: Submit Service Request and Register for Processing
user_stories.description:
As a Customer, I want to submit a service request and attach the required information, so that my request can be received and registered in the system for processing.

This story covers the initial submission step common to both generic workflows (Workflow 1 - Service Request Without Payment, and Workflow 2 - Service Request With Payment). After the customer submits the request with the required attachments, the system receives it and registers it, moving it into a 'Request Under Processing' state ahead of review by the competent authority. [REAL PUT TEST EDIT]
acceptance_criteria: As a Customer, I want to submit a service request so that it can be processed by the competent authority
As a Customer, I want to attach required information/documents to the request so that the reviewer has what they need to make a decision
The system receives the submitted service request
The system registers the submitted request, moving it into an 'Under Processing' status
This submission and registration behavior applies consistently to both the with-payment and without-payment service request workflows
